notes: Three waws in the numeral phrase answer to three English ands, each standing between the same pair of numerals, so the ASV's twenty and nine still gives its and to the units-to-tens waw (rule 42).
The waw of wayehi takes the connective even, which is written for it; the verb takes the copular was (rules 14, 21).
The attributive article on asuy is rendered by the relative that and heads on it (rule 41).
